H01.description: reply.header('set-cookie', array) stores the caller's array by reference, so later set-cookie calls push into it and mutate the caller's (often module-level) array, making cookies accumulate and leak across requests.

H03.description: Adds a regression test that a caller's set-cookie array is not mutated across requests.

I01.description: Stream trailer flushing race/hang in sendStream is unrelated to the set-cookie header change under review, and the head-side code for it is not shown, so it cannot be attributed to head from the available text.
